claims.text: Outpt mild w.draw: tapering regimen of benzodiazepines or gabapentin, w a support person
claims.quote: In the outpatient setting, mild alcohol withdrawal syndrome can be treated using a tapering regimen of either benzodiazepines or gabapentin administered with the assistance of a support person.

claims.text: Carbamazepine, gabapentin or valproic acid (⍉liver dx or preg): adjunct to benzodiazepines or when they are contraindicated
claims.quote: Carbamazepine , gabapentin , or valproic acid (when there is no liver disease or pregnancy) may also be used as an adjunct to benzodiazepines or when benzodiazepines are contraindicated

claims.text: Carbamazepine 200 mg orally 4 × a day may be used as an alt, then tapered
claims.quote: Carbamazepine 200 mg orally 4 times a day may be used as an alternative and then tapered.

claims.text: AUD: gabapentin, topiramate or baclofen may be used though ⍉FDA-approved
claims.quote: Though not FDA-approved to treat AUD, medications such as gabapentin, topiramate, or baclofen may be used in the treatment of AUD.
